name: multi-select-review-screen
for: The review screen a multi-select question moves on to, captured live (#176) after ticking two boxes and pressing Right — the first real capture of this screen in the corpus; multi-question-review-screen was reconstructed from the runtime's binary. It carries the same tab bar as the question before it, so this case pins that the tab bar alone does not make a prompt multi-select: this screen must stay an ordinary two-option prompt that respond answers with choice 1, never a target for choices.
redactedFrom: real capture, redacted by corpus-redact (one runtime build, 2026-09-23)
